BENGALURU, TUESDAY, 21, NOVEMBER, 2023(KARTHIKA, 30, SHAKAVARSHA, 1945) Volume - 158 Issue 224

KARNATAKA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
(DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATIONS)
UDYOGA SOUDHA : BANGALORE - 1.

No.PSC 530 DE 898/2023-2024 Dated :26/10/2023

The results of the Departmental Examinations II-Session 2021 held by the Commission
during June & July-2023(Excluding Sub.Code 47,72 & 73)is as follows:
1)The Subject-wise Provisional List of Register Numbers of the candidates who have
passed is given in APPENDIX-A.
2)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers who have passed only in certain papers
by obtaining exemption and who have obtained the exemption being a Law or Commerce
graduate is given in APPENDIX-B.
3)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers of the candidates exempted from appearing
for a particular paper or papers, subject to passing the examination as a whole
within the next two years is given in APPENDIX-C.
4)List of With-held and Cancelled register numbers of the candidates is given in
APPENDIX-D.

Note : Retotalling option is available only for descriptive papers. Candidates who wish
to apply may do so by paying Rs.100/paper through Online within 30 days of
publication of this notification

The results of the Departmental Examinations II-Session 2021 held by the Commission
during June & July-2023(Excluding Sub.Code 47,72 & 73)is as follows:
1)The Subject-wise Provisional List of Register Numbers of the candidates who have
passed is given in APPENDIX-A.

by obtaining exemption and who have obtained the exemption being a Law or Commerce
graduate is given in APPENDIX-B.

for a particular paper or papers, subject to passing the examination as a whole
within the next two years is given in APPENDIX-C.

The results of the Departmental Examinations II-Session 2021 held by the Commission
during June & July-2023(Excluding Sub.Code 47,72 & 73)is as follows:
1)The Subject-wise Provisional List of Register Numbers of the candidates who have
passed is given in APPENDIX-A.
2)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers who have passed only in certain papers
by obtaining exemption and who have obtained the exemption being a Law or Commerce
graduate is given in APPENDIX-B.
3)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers of the candidates exempted from appearing
for a particular paper or papers, subject to passing the examination as a whole
within the next two years is given in APPENDIX-C.
4)List of With-held and Cancelled register numbers of the candidates is given in
APPENDIX-D.

Note : Retotalling option is available only for descriptive papers. Candidates who wish
to apply may do so by paying Rs.100/paper through Online within 30 days of
publication of this notification

graduate is given in APPENDIX-B.

within the next two years is given in APPENDIX-C.

APPENDIX-D.
